status_detail: News and state filing coverage describe a Bastrop County EdgeConneX campus near Wolf Lane/FM 535 in Cedar Creek: AUS02 is a $440M 578,000 sq ft first building, part of a four-building $1.44B campus; subsequent reports describe two additional $700M buildings, EDCAUS11 and EDCAUS12, on a nearly 180-acre site at 6682 FM 535. project_name: Pacifico Cedar Creek data center and power campus
developer: Pacifico Energy / Pacifico Cedar Creek LLC
status_detail: Pacifico Cedar Creek LLC filed a June 24, 2026 Texas Comptroller/JETI application for a 2,842-acre site at 382 Earl Callahan Road pairing an unnamed data center tenant with a $2.24B 710 MW gas-fired power facility; Community Impact says county tax-abatement and mass-grading permit applications were submitted and preliminary review was underway. The project could begin operating by 2028 if selected/approved.
notes: Capacity is the reported data center computing load; power plant is reported as 710 MW. Site selection remained conditional versus an Ohio site, so status is planned rather than approved.

status_detail: Meta announced the Temple data center in 2022 as a nearly 900,000 sq ft, $800M facility; KWTX reported on 2026-07-22 that Meta officially opened the Industrial Boulevard AI data center and that the campus spans more than 760,000 sq ft across two buildings with more than $1.2B investment. JE Dunn describes the construction scope as a 386-acre, three-building greenfield campus totaling 152 MW.
notes: Operator source confirms project and original investment; local news confirms opening/operational status; MW from contractor project page.

project_name: Rowan Temple hyperscale data center campus
status_detail: Rowan's project page says Temple is a 700-acre, 300 MW hyperscale campus with minimum $700M investment, entitlements in 2025, construction started in late 2025 and substantial completion targeted for 2027. Temple EDC says City Council unanimously approved the project on more than 700 acres along Bob White Road in south Temple, with Bell County collaboration.
notes: Bell County FAQ confirms commissioners had discussions with Rowan engineering staff; county has no moratorium authority and is using tax abatement terms as its main control point.
